% Pattern: head/nested. Bold case and claim heads inside a proof environment
% are items nested in the proof (AX3.5), and the head written again at the
% start of a proof is not a second proof. Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=theorem-1
% want head-1 other/case 1
% want head-2 statement/claim -
% want head-3 proof - proves=head-2
% want head-4 other/case 2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}
Every compact space is bounded.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
\noindent{\it Proof.} Take a cover by balls.

\textbf{Case 1:} The cover is finite. Then the space is bounded.

\textbf{Claim.} A finite union of balls is bounded.

\emph{Proof of the claim.} Take the largest radius. $\square$

\textbf{Case 2:} The cover is infinite. Take a finite subcover.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
